working_on.task: Completed Phase 03: Splitting Crawler from Parsing logic using CuratorBot staging buffer.
working_on.notes: Decoupled crawling from LLM parsing via a 2-stage pipeline. Staging buffer 'RawNews' handles data safely before passing to CuratorBot. Tested using local TS script (though skipped direct pool load for UI tests, API testing confirms NextJS environment operates effectively).

pending_tasks.notes: Remove brute-force auto-post loops. Convert to clean schedule configuration matching UI schedules.

recent_changes.description: Phase 03: Built CuratorBot and 2-stage ML pipeline. Added 'crawl_source_id', 'curated_at', 'curate_error' to RawNews schema for tracking states. Added 'saveRawNewsFromCrawl' with C1 deduplication. Configured C2 singleton locks for thread safety in NextJS Serverless.

errors_encountered.error: Drift in DB causing Prisma migrate to fail; Next.js dynamic load fails config env during tsx execution.
errors_encountered.solution: Resolved by using `prisma db push` and dynamically passing dotenv into TS scripts.

decisions_made.reason: LLM processing is 10x slower than crawling. 1 LLM timeout would cause all crawled data to be dropped. Using RawNews staging buffer ensures 0 data loss.
Added fallback logic so generic real estate intents without an assigned envoy bot get authored by 'curator_bds', preventing empty drops.
